verdict.rationale: Aider's docs describe giving natural-language instructions that it applies as file edits (interactively, via --message, or by voice for features and bug fixes). You can add several files to the chat, or let aider work out which files to edit, and it uses a map of the whole repository. Community users report it delivering from the first prompt on existing codebases, though some note subtle errors and diff problems with certain models. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on examples of coordinated edits spanning multiple files, and independent corroboration of output reliability (community reports of subtle errors).
